messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — while bringing up starcoder-2 I hit a generation_config mismatch that led to subtle chat-template token shifts.
izzy: what ended up being different?
morgan: HF model had explicit `bos_token_id`/`eos_token_id` set (1/2) in config.json, tokenizer.pad_token_id is null, and our chat template inserts <|pad|> for alignment. that made token ids in compiled KV cache off-by-one for some quantized kernels.
taylor: oh no. did it only show up after quantization?
morgan: yes, Q4 configs exposed it more because the kernel assumes fixed token id map for embeddings lookup. float32 run masked the issue.
sam: can you paste the HF generation_config snippet so I can see mapping rules?
morgan: sure — here's the minimal snippet we saw:```json
{"bos_token_id":1,"eos_token_id":2,"repetition_penalty":1.1,"top_k":50,"top_p":0.92}
```
izzy: two things to watch: 1) HF sometimes uses `-1` or `null` for top_k/top_p to mean disabled; 2) `repetition_penalty` semantics vary (HF applies multiplicative on logits whereas our legacy mapping expected additive).
morgan: exactly. we were mapping directly: `top_k:-1 -> 0`, `top_p:null -> 1.0`, `repetition_penalty: as-is` which broke some beam/rerank comparisons.
eval-bot: perf/regression: run 2026-03-18 12:10 UTC — +2.3% codegen edit distance vs baseline when repetition_penalty remained unmapped.
taylor: recommended mapping from my quick audit: `top_k <= 0 -> 0`, `top_p == null -> 1.0`, for `repetition_penalty` if value==1.0 treat as noop; otherwise ensure we use HF multiplicative semantics (logits /= penalty for token==prev?). add comment in converter.
sam: also add check: if `bos_token_id`/`eos_token_id` exist but `pad_token_id` is null, and template contains PAD placeholders, warn and suggest `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'pad_token':'<|pad|>'})` or map PAD to eos as fallback.
morgan: created a small patch so converter emits warnings and a canonical mapping table. pasted patch gist:```py
# mapping helpers
def map_top_k(hf_k):
    return 0 if hf_k in (-1, None) else int(hf_k)

def map_top_p(hf_p):
    return 1.0 if hf_p is None else float(hf_p)

# repetition penalty: keep multiplicative semantics
def map_rep_penalty(v):
    return 1.0 if v in (None, 1) else float(v)
```
izzy: can we also normalize `temperature` to float and clamp small values to 1e-6 to avoid divide-by-zero in softmax? seen crashes with `temperature:0` in some model wrappers.
morgan: good call. added `temperature = max(1e-6, float(temp))`.
sam: for regression tracking, add an eval that compares token alignment for first 256 tokens between HF python generate and Redwood runtime (same seed, sampling params). flag any token-id differences.
eval-bot: added to nightly evals -> job id rwd-eval-20260319-02. will post diffs if >0 mismatches.
taylor: note for docs: explicit mention that HF `generation_config.json` may include legacy keys like `penalty_alpha` or `no_repeat_ngram_size` — map or warn. prefer to emit a `conversion_notes` field in the model metadata after import.
morgan: ok I'll open a PR with converter changes + unit tests + a short MIGRATION note. anyone want to review the rep-penalty portion?
izzy: i'll take it — will check edge cases: negative penalties, >2.0, and interplay with top_p/top_k.
sam: thanks — huge help catching this before it hit prod. :thumbsup:
